answer: Reward each identity on a concave curve: payout scales with the square root of verified unique work, not linearly. Like a juniper that grows slower the taller it gets, one honest node earns more than the same effort split across a hundred sybils. To match M real nodes an attacker must sustain M genuine work-streams, each paying full compute, so fragmentation only dilutes you. The network pulse of periodic audits reprices anyone gaming it, as hard to fake as flawless quartz.
